text:
maria: FYI CI failing on audit-validate: goldenset mismatch after the KMS key rotation test. Anyone else seeing this?
ajay: I see it — validator reports missing field in a subset: 'encryption.metadata.kms_key_id' absent in some customer samples. Might be redaction from the new KMS flow.
sam: Which CI job exactly? audit-validate/golden-check?
maria: audit-validate:ci job 1243. Output shows 12/500 golden mismatches. Sample below.
jen: Paste the sample please.
maria: ```
{
  "event_type": "key.rotate",
  "actor": { "id": "svc-deployer", "type": "service" },
  "encryption": { "algorithm": "kms-aes-256" /* kms_key_id missing */ }
}
```
sec-bot: automated note: schema-validator v2.1.0 ran; mismatch: path '/encryption/metadata/kms_key_id' expected string but got null (12 events).
ajay: Our KMS plugin for private deployments now returns an opaque ref token instead of the raw key id in some flows; golden fixtures are still asserting explicit key ids. Two possible paths: migrate golden to refs or normalize refs before comparison.
sam: Quick options: (A) update JSON schema to accept nullable kms_key_id, (B) add a normalizer in the validator that maps refs -> canonical placeholder for golden comparison. What's the compliance impact?
maria: We can't drop or null customer-visible kms identifiers silently — audit logs must show something traceable for compliance. Normalizer is safer; it preserves the shape and keeps golden stable.
jen: Proposal: validator preprocessor step that replaces any KMS opaque refs with the canonical string "kms:REDACTED" for golden-check runs. That keeps CI deterministic and still exposes if fields are missing entirely.
ajay: Works for hosted tests. For Private/on-prem customers who expect real key ids, add a fixture metadata flag like "expect_kms_refs": true so CI runs both modes on the small golden subset.
sam: I'll open a PR with two changes: (1) add normalizer preprocessor, (2) modify audit-validate job to run the small golden subset in both modes. @ajay can you review?
maria: :thumbsup: tag this as P1 for today and add to incident queue if fallout increases. Also grep customer logs to ensure no production events are missing kms_key_id.
ops-bot: deploy bot: rolling deploy of schema-validator v2.1.1 to staging started.
jen: Test plan for PR: run `pytest tests/audit_validation/test_golden.py::test_kms_refs -k normalizer` and paste output. Example command: `CI=true ./scripts/run_golden_checks --mode=both`.
ajay: I'll backfill the 12 failing golden cases with normalized expectations and re-run CI. ETA ~2h.
maria: Thanks — if any customer-facing regressions appear, open an incident and tag eng-security + cs. For now mark severity: low and keep monitoring.
sam: :eyes: on CI, will follow up with PR link and changelog snippet.
